description: This file implements an Exchange calendar service class with methods for creating, updating, deleting events, and listing calendars, utilizing the ews-javascript-api library and custom encryption and logging utilities.

classes.name: ExchangeCalendarService
classes.description: A class implementing calendar operations for Exchange, including event management and calendar listing.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event in Exchange with specified details and attendees.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event identified by UID with new details.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event by UID.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Retrieves busy dates for selected calendars within a date range.

methods.name: listCalendars
methods.description: Lists available Exchange calendars excluding deleted items.

methods.name: getExchangeService
methods.description: Initializes and returns an ExchangeService instance with proper credentials and settings.
